title: Water Potability Prediction with MLOps
summary: An end-to-end MLOps project that predicts water potability from water-quality metrics, using MLflow for experiment tracking, DVC for data versioning, and a Streamlit/Tkinter app for deployment. The app and a companion notebook fit an SDV CTGANSynthesizer on the potability data and call SDV's evaluate_quality/run_diagnostic functions to generate and validate a synthetic dataset page in the app.
